source.note: 165 Prophet plans ingested; 76 have close-price history for charts.

content_types.name: Signal Alert
content_types.desc: A Prophet plan turned into a cashtag post with a price chart showing where we see opportunity.

content_types.name: Chart of the Day
content_types.desc: A single annotated price or macro chart that tells one clear story without commentary.

content_types.name: Plain-English Explainer
content_types.desc: A short thread or post that explains one market concept so a non-professional can act on it.

content_types.name: Macro Note
content_types.desc: A brief plain read on the big picture (rates, liquidity, growth) and what it means right now.

content_types.name: Report Card
content_types.desc: A public update on how a past call played out: the numbers, the outcome, what we learned.

content_types.name: On Our Radar
content_types.desc: A short list of names we're watching closely this week but haven't acted on yet.

content_types.name: Event Reaction
content_types.desc: A fast-turnaround post reacting to a market-moving event with context and what we'd watch next.

content_types.name: Mover of the Day
content_types.desc: The day's single biggest mover, charted, on its cashtag, with the real move %.

content_types.name: Theme Tape
content_types.desc: One post tagged with 6-10 cashtags covering a group that's moving, the reach king at 0 followers.

accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.headline: $QUBT keeps failing at the same level
queue.body: The 9.14 average turned it away for the 4th time in the past year. Until that level clears, the latest bounce hasn't changed the structure.

queue.headline: $HD lost its long-term average at 344
queue.body: Below it, 333 is where the most shares changed hands over the past six months.

Jobless claims: 199k weekly average, 12.8% below last year
GDPNow: 5.8% annualized growth this quarter
Median CPI: 3.1% annual rate
Growth isn't folding. Inflation's still warm.

$ENR: 6th test of 19.8 held
Below 19.8, the repeated support is gone.

$NGVT is 1.8% above the busiest price of the past six months.
That price is 74.8.
Below 74.8, the six-month volume shelf is gone.
$MGY turned away again. 27.3 remains the ceiling.
$APO holds 127 for the fifth time in the past year.

queue.headline: $KALU pushed to a fresh high
queue.body: A close above 190 keeps the breakout intact.

queue.headline: $TTD just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 78% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 802 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.

queue.headline: Commodities Metals selling off, -1.3% avg on Wednesday
queue.body: $PAAS -6.0% $AREC -4.6% $SVM -3.3% $EXK -3.2% $ATLX -3.2% $SBSW -3.2% $AG -3.1% $MTA -3.1% Breadth inside the group, not one loser.

accounts.name: Founder's desk: the day's tape, two facts set against each other

queue.headline: $VAL closes green 3 weeks running
queue.body: Still below the price where the most shares traded over six months.
GDPNow has growth at 5.8% while median CPI runs at 3.1%. Growth and inflation are both still warm.

$XLV sits near the bottom of today's most-traded names.
A record close still isn't pulling much attention.

queue.body: $HD lost 344. The next close settles whether the break holds.

queue.headline: $HRMY tightens after another green close
queue.body: The advance only matters if 39 holds. Below that level, the range hasn't resolved.
Salazar's $CARR sale surfaced 10 days later. A filing, not a call.

accounts.name: Crowd translator — market psychology, mood vs positioning, consumer and tech stories with market consequence

queue.body: Jobless claims are averaging 199k this month, 12.8% below a year ago. The labor market isn't confirming the softer growth data.

The recent run has $SMR pressing 9.82.
A close above the level keeps the rebound intact.

queue.headline: SOFI's July 29 volume spike left 17 as the average price paid.
queue.body: $SOFI is still holding that line.

queue.headline: $FANG found buyers again at its 30-week average.
queue.body: Below 167, the long-term hold is gone.
$EU held the six-month price shelf at 1.30. Below it, the base is gone
Rep. Mike Kelly sold $PEP. The disclosure arrived 26 days later, not a call.

queue.body:
$CVCO held 588, the six-month most-traded price.
The rebound has to keep it.

queue.headline: TechnipFMC, $FTI, has to defend 74.1
queue.body: Above that line, 91.8 stays in play. Below it, the breakout case is gone.
Broadcom, $AVGO, has held 390 for 10 straight sessions.
CMC, $CMC, still holds 67.4, the average price paid since Jun 26.
Gates, $GTES, needs 28.2 back before the next leg is real.
Hudson Steven Kenneth, CEO of $PNAQ, opened a new $2.25M position. The filing confirms the purchase but gives no reason for it.
Director Brian Cox opened a new $AMRC position with a $995K buy. Filing, not a call.
